title: MyBB & SMF imports — plus hardened XenForo & phpBB
notes: The Import wizard gains MyBB (1.8) and SMF (2.0 & 2.1) — members, forums, topics and posts with BBCode converted. XenForo and phpBB are now verified against their real schemas (XenForo passwords now carry over correctly; phpBB skips empty container forums). Where passwords can’t safely transfer, those members reset on first login.

changelog.text: MyBB (1.8) and SMF / Simple Machines Forum (2.0 & 2.1) importers — members, forums, topics and posts with BBCode converted.
XenForo & phpBB importers verified against real schemas (no longer beta): XenForo passwords now carry over (was a skip bug); phpBB skips empty container forums.
